name: NX4 KOR: Tucson NX4 (Korea)
description: HMG-API add-on for the Korean Tucson NX4 (260902) with a manager app. The app shows the USB install progress and checks HMG-API and the official Wireless CarPlay + Android Auto mod (wireless-carplay-aa) on this car (versions, boot guard, hooks and map, the projection Wi-Fi AP and Wi-Fi part, other Wi-Fi packages), says what blocks wireless projection and what to do, and counts CarPlay connections. It can request a reboot, held back while installing or near the HMG-API boot guard, and asks before the USB installer collects a diagnostic log. Beside the official mod, it fits CarPlay turn-by-turn on the cluster and HUD to the Korean car (Korea Projection's fit with HMG-Seogaemo's lane glyphs: an arrow for every maneuver, the near-turn view and distance bar, a resend every second), so the cluster no longer stops on a maneuver the official table has no icon for. On a unit with no Wi-Fi chip (the stock driver gives up at boot), it stops HMG-API's projection AP retries for that boot, which would otherwise start a Dalvik process every 30 seconds. For a USB Wi-Fi dongle on such a unit (Realtek RTL88x2BU or RTL8831BU), it carries both drivers and, at each boot, binds the one for the plugged dongle over the stock Wi-Fi driver file (no system file changed), so the stock Wi-Fi and HMG-API bring the projection AP up on it; after the stock unit power-cycles the USB port, it turns the AP off and on once if the AP was left down, and it watches for the dongle being plugged in or re-plugged later (or the unit waking up) and brings it up the same way without the manager app button.
